bundle.shortDescription: Desktop workspace for Strata runtimes and local model services
bundle.longDescription: Strata Manager is an independent community desktop workspace for installing and updating Strata runtimes, managing local models and runtime configurations, and operating managed background services and local APIs. Download official ZIP releases, review release notes, edit configurations with forms or JSON, and use chat, monitoring, persistent API statistics and parameter tuning alongside your current service. Model inference is provided by upstream Strata.
